headline: Funding for the Merrimack Corridor Development Project, including $395,000 in ARPA funds and $300,000 in CPA funds for 118 affordable rental homes.
summary: Two funding motions are on the agenda for the project. The $300,000 loan motion is subject to city legal and department review.
items: Questions for RENU and the Lowell Housing Authority on the Merrimack Corridor Development Project
Motion to award $395,000 in ARPA funds to RENU and the Lowell Housing Authority for the project
Motion to award a $300,000 soft loan of CPA funds to RENU and the Lowell Housing Authority for 118 affordable rental units in Lowell's Acre neighborhood, subject to city due diligence
Update on new funding opportunities from city executive staff
location: Lowell City Hall, 375 Merrimack Street, 2nd Floor (Mayor's Reception Room), and via Zoom

# Lowell Affordable Housing Trust

*Meeting Agenda*

Date: November 23, 2026

Time: 4:30 PM

Location: Lowell City Hall (375 Merrimack Street) – 2nd Floor (*Mayor's Reception Room*) and via Zoom, remote participation

## AGENDA:

I. **Welcome & Accept Communication/ Remote Participation (Zoom)** Communication Remote / Zoom Participation: *Meetings Will Be Held via Zoom Using Remote Participation As Follows: Members Of The Public May View The Meeting Via LTC.Org (On-Line; Live Streaming; Or Local Cable Channel 6). Those Wishing To Speak Regarding A Specific Agenda Item Shall Register To Speak In Advance Of The Meeting By Sending Email To DPD With A Phone Number To Call So That You May Be Issued Zoom Link To The Meeting. Email Address Is gcoulouras@lowellma.gov. If No Access to Email You May Contact DPD At 978-674-1412. All Request Must Be Done Before 12:00 PM On The Day Of Meeting. For Zoom assistance - HTTPS://SUPPORT.ZOOM.US/HC/EN-US/ARTICLES/201362193-JOINING-A-MEETING*

II. Roll Call

III. Call Meeting to Order

IV. Approve Minutes of November 18, 2026, AHTF Board Meeting

V. **New Business** – Questions presented to the Revitalization Effort Toward New Urbanism, Inc. ("RENU") Mr. Michael Lozano and Sherry Giblin of The Lowell Housing Authority (LHA) for The Merrimack Corridor Development Project. RENU, who is requesting $300,000.00 of CPC sourced funding from the AHTF to assist in the creation of 118 affordable rental homes. RENU is also requesting an additional $395,000.00 of ARPA sourced funding from The AHTF to assist in the creation of the same 118 affordable rental homes which are up to 80% AMI across two buildings in Lowell's Acre neighborhood.

VI. **Discussion**

VII. **Old Business-**Motion to vote an award the appropriation of $395,000.00 in American Rescue Plan Act (ARPA) funds from the City of Lowell Affordable Housing Trust to the Revitalization Effort Toward New Urbanism, Inc. ("RENU") and The Lowell Housing Authority for The Merrimack Corridor Development Project.

VIII. **Discussion**

IX. **Old Business—**Motion to vote an award the appropriation of $300,000.00 in Community Preservation Act (CPA) funds awarded to The Community Preservation Committee (CPC) from state and local sources then awarded to The City of Lowell Affordable Housing Trust Fund (AHTF) for the creation of affordable housing. The motion is to award a "soft" loan sourced from these funds to the Revitalization Effort Toward New Urbanism Inc. ("RENU") and The Lowell Housing Authority For the Merrimack Corridor Development Project to assist in the creation of 118 affordable rental units which range from 30-80% AMI in Lowell's Acre neighborhood, subject to and contingent upon the law department and all other City of Lowell related departments due diligence and compliance satisfactory to all related federal, state, and local laws.

X. **Discussion**

XI. **Old Business-** Update of new funding opportunities from The City of Lowell Executive Staff

XII. **Discussion**

XIII. Scheduled next meeting is for December 16, 2026 @ 4:30 in The MRR 2nd Floor City Hall

XIV. Adjournment
